messages:
Alex: Heads-up — we saw ~30% pod evictions for dedicated-tenant pools in eu-west-1 during yesterday's prewarm window. Looks like cluster-autoscaler didn't add the preemptible nodes in time. Anyone else see this?
Maria: saw logs. most pods were pending waiting for nodeSelector gpu:dense-rtx. CA scaled but the spot instance type we prefer took 6m to come up.
Devon: SRE looked into it — two issues: (1) our nodepool prewarm target only applies to hosted pools, not dedicated, and (2) cloud provider returned capacity delayed due to region quota burst.
Kai: Is this the same latency we hit last month where fallback to hosted failed due to VPC egress ACLs?
Maria: Not the same. This time requests were routed to eu-west-1-dedicated pool but because prewarm_min=0 for dedicated it waited for demand then hit ASG cold start.
Alex: Suggestion: change dedicated pools to prewarm_min=1 for critical tenant namespaces + add grace window in CA scale-down to avoid thrash.
Devon: Prewarm_min=1 for all dedicated is expensive. Billing flagged that dedicated nodes idle cost spiked 40%.
billing-bot: Automated note: estimated incremental monthly cost for prewarm_min=1 in eu-west-1 (2xA100 equiv) = $26,400.
Kai: Could we make prewarm conditional per-namespace SLA label? e.g., namespace annotations: redwood.io/prewarm: "on-demand" | "always"
Maria: +1. That way critical tenants pay for their prewarm via a chargeback label. Could integrate with cost center tagging.
Alex: Also need a network note — when we try cross-region fallback (route to hosted), some tenants hit egress restrictions (customer VPC). We saw 403s from firewall. We should only fallback if tenant allows cross-region routing.
Devon: Agreed. Proposed policy: fallback_to_hosted = false unless namespace.annotation['redwood.io/fallback-hosted'] == 'true' and network_policy allows egress to hosted endpoint.
Kai: Implementation detail: update admission controller to inject annotation defaults and a webhook to validate network egress rules.
Maria: Quick CA config snippet I tested locally (helps avoid immediate scale-up churn):
```yaml
clusterAutoscaler:
  scaleDown:
    enabled: true
    delayAfterAdd: 10m
  nodeGroups:
    - name: dedicated-eu-gpu
      minSize: 1  # keep prewarm for critical tenants via selector
      maxSize: 50
      labels:
        pool: dedicated
      taints:
        - key: dedicated
          value: "true"
          effect: NO_SCHEDULE
```
Devon: One caveat: taint+toleration only isolates scheduling, not chargeback. We'll need scheduler-extender or K8s priority classes to prefer dedicated for paying tenants.
Alex: For short term, can we do a hybrid: prewarm_min=1 for a small set of namespaces (prod-only), and a separate spot-backed burst pool for lower priority workloads?
Maria: yes. Also enable faster instance type fallback: allow CA to request alternative GPU SKUs within same AZ to shorten cold-start. CA already supports multiple instanceTypes but our policy limited it.
Kai: Ops checklist:
- [ ] add namespace annotation for fallback-hosted
- [ ] add chargeback tags for prewarm nodes
- [ ] config change to CA to allow multiple GPU SKUs
- [ ] update infra-bot to alert when evictions > 10% in 10m window
Alex: I'll own the prewarm rollout for prod namespaces. Devon, can you handle the admission webhook for fallback control?
Devon: On it, starting a PR. Will add unit tests for annotation parsing and ensure webhook is idempotent.
infra-bot: Incident note created: #INC-2026-438 -> dedicated pool evictions eu-west-1, linked to autoscale cold starts.
billing-bot: FYI — I'll post a breakdown of projected prewarm costs per tenant in the billing channel after Devon's PR includes the chargeback tags.
Maria: Great. If we can gate fallback by annotation and keep smarter prewarm for prod, we avoid cross-region egress surprises and limit costs. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks all — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review PR + CA tuning results.
Kai: adding calendar invite.
Maria: dropping logs and CA debug output in the thread: `kubectl describe pod gpu-pending-xyz` showed Pending: "0/6 nodes are available: 6 node(s) didn't match node selector"
Devon: will attach autoscaler debug dump to PR.
Alex: End of thread for now.
